provenance.source: R20UT5336EJ0112 Rev.1.12, §4.1.1 "ONNX Operators", table "Supported ONNX Operator List" (PDF pp. 12-17)
provenance.note: Hand-transcribed: the DRP-AI Translator publishes no machine-readable report, only this vendor PDF manual, so this table is NOT reproducible by scripts/gen_npu_ops.py. `pins.drp_compiler_version` mirrors the '100' default in rzv_drp-ai_tvm/tutorials/arg_parser.py, which tan.model.adapters.drpai (tan-cli; formerly scripts/alp_model/adapters/drpai.py here before ADR-0028) never overrides -- a different compiler_version is not represented by this list. DRP-AI TVM wraps this Translator as its backend codegen, but TVM's own Relay pattern gate is stricter and a second opaque MERA2 partitioner sits behind it -- so this list can only rule an op OUT (absent from the Translator's ONNX vocabulary), never certify TVM/MERA2 will actually place a present op on the DRP-AI; hence stance=screening, same as the tool-generated tables. One correction against the literal PDF text: the summary table spells operator #38 "Sofplus" (missing the 't'); this is a vendor-doc typo, not a second spelling -- the same document's own §4.1.2 detail section (PDF p.26) uses the correct ONNX operator name "Softplus", which is what is recorded below so op-name comparisons against a real ONNX graph actually match.
